title: Iter Sibiricum: European travelogues about Siberia and its peoples, 1800–1930 (resource v1.0)
description:
A digital research resource on how European travellers of 1800–1930 described the peoples of Siberia and the relations between them. This release archives the website (https://iter-sibiricum.ru/) together with its data and the reproducible processing pipeline: a corpus of 109 travelogues in 9 languages with paragraph-level permanent identifiers, routes reconstructed from the texts with supporting quotations, a gazetteer in Linked Places Format, cards of peoples, 3,029 illustrations from the books with checked captions, analytics (frequencies, collocations, discourses, networks, text reuse, statistical models of expert annotation) and the scripts that produce them.

Prepared with the support of the Russian Science Foundation, grant No. 25-28-20397 (https://rscf.ru/project/25-28-20397/), and the Government of the Altai Republic.
